races.paceDynamic: Endofastorm will be the lone pace-setter in this small field, able to dictate terms without pressure from the rail or outside. The six hold-up horses will settle in behind, creating a bunched group that will need to find gaps and rely on finishing kicks in the straight. With good-to-firm ground favouring sustained galloping and the extended trip allowing hold-up horses to get organized, this tactical scenario heavily favours the prominent runner who can control the tempo. The race shape strongly benefits front-running tactics, as Endofastorm can set conservative fractions and prove difficult to peg back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Endofastorm Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Endofastorm sets steady fractions without early pressure from the field
scenarios.body: The pace-setter dictates ideal splits and has plenty left for the finish, while the hold-up horses get caught flat-footed on quick ground. The lone front-runner proves impossible to catch once establishing a comfortable lead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swamp Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the gallop becomes too steady and multiple closers get organized together
scenarios.body: The bunched field produces a cavalry charge in the straight that overwhelms Endofastorm's finishing kick. Superior class among the hold-up horses tells when they all get clear runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses decides to take the race to Endofastorm earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The pace quickens mid-race, stretching the field and creating a true test of stamina over the extended trip. This brings the stronger stayers into prominence while exposing the weaker finishers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Suits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the steady gallop becomes a sprint finish with traffic problems in the straight
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get in each other's way while Endofastorm ties up, allowing a horse with a clean passage to strike late. The tactical nature of the finish creates an upset opportunity.

watchPoints.text: Watch if any hold-up horse tries to go with Endofastorm early, as this would completely change the tactical complexion and exhaust the front-runner.
Watch Endofastorm's fractions in the first half-mile - if too quick, the hold-up horses will have a real chance in the straight.
Watch for traffic problems in the straight with so many hold-up horses needing room, as clean passages will be crucial.
Watch Bohemian Breeze for signs of readiness after 32 days off, as his class could tell if he's fit enough.
Watch the pace through the middle furlongs - if it becomes pedestrian, multiple closers could swamp Endofastorm together.

races.paceDynamic: Rating will set a steady tempo from prominent position with Bobby Dassler the only other horse likely to race handy early. Behind them sits a wall of hold-up horses including Party Island, Thapa Vc, Raintown, Moby Quick and Paps Of Jura who will all need the pace to develop. With minimal early pressure on Rating, the gallop will be controlled through the middle stages before the hold-up brigade fan out wide turning for home. This tactical setup clearly favours the prominent racers who can secure good positions without energy expenditure, as the hold-up horses face a bottleneck effect trying to find racing room simultaneously.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Rating Sustains Lead
scenarios.trigger: If Rating maintains his rhythm and Bobby Dassler provides token company through halfway
scenarios.body: The pace will be too steady for the massed hold-up ranks to peg back, allowing Rating to kick clear when Rossa Ryan asks. His recent third at softer tracks suggests he's ready to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the six closers all arrive together and get shuffled for room in the straight
scenarios.body: Several will meet trouble in running while one or two get clear runs to capitalize on Rating's fading effort. Party Island's stamina and Thapa Vc's class could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bobby Dassler Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the 7-year-old can stalk Rating closely and produce his turn-of-foot
scenarios.body: His recent Wolverhampton win shows he's in form and the 9lb weight advantage gives him a serious chance to outstay Rating. The prominent pair could dominate.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Swooper Special
scenarios.trigger: If one hold-up horse gets the dream run through when others are stopped
scenarios.body: Moby Quick or Raintown could benefit from traffic problems ahead to deliver a telling late thrust. The pace would need to be truly crawling early.

watchPoints.text: Rating faces no early pressure which could allow him to dictate fractions that suit his stamina reserves
Bobby Dassler's recent win and significant weight advantage make him dangerous if tracking the leader closely
The six hold-up horses will create a cavalry charge effect that could result in traffic problems turning in
Party Island's course-and-distance win gives him specific venue knowledge in a tactical puzzle
Thapa Vc carries strong recent form but his hold-up style is compromised by the race shape

races.paceDynamic: Alkuwarrior is the only confirmed front runner but returns from a 252-day absence, creating uncertainty about his fitness to sustain the gallop. Four horses (Saucy Jane, Duskaura, Solar Invincible, Guernsey Angel) all want prominent positions, which will create congestion and potential traffic problems turning for home. With five hold-up horses including the class acts Comic Strip and Alvin sitting behind this early scrap, the pace should be honest enough to set up the race for the closers. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and finish with one sustained run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Benefit Most
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners engage early and Alkuwarrior's fitness tells
scenarios.body: The pace becomes genuinely run with the four prominent horses scrapping for position while the returning Alkuwarrior fades. Comic Strip, Angel Numbers, London Is Blue and Alvin all get the strong pace they need to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Solar Invincible or Duskaura can secure a clear run from their forward positions
scenarios.body: The pace is solid but not destructive, allowing the better prominent runners to stay in touch without over-racing. Solar Invincible's light weight or Duskaura's consistent 5f form could prove decisive when the closers are still organising.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Alkuwarrior Returns Fresh
scenarios.trigger: If the long-absent leader proves fitter than expected and gets soft fractions
scenarios.body: With no genuine pace pressure, Alkuwarrior steals crucial lengths on the field and has enough left to resist the late rally. The hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet create severe interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Multiple runners get hampered or have to switch wide, allowing a horse with a clear passage to benefit from others' misfortune. Artista or one of the other hold-up horses could capitalise on a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Alkuwarrior's fitness after 252 days off - if he goes too fast early he'll fold dramatically in the final furlong
Traffic problems at the two-furlong pole where four prominent runners may converge and block the closers' runs
Solar Invincible's early position with Edmunds riding - if caught wide he'll have no chance from his forward style
Comic Strip's jump from the stalls as a hold-up horse - needs to avoid being too far back on this sharp track
Jockey Hornby's tactics on Saucy Jane in the crowded prominent battle - must not let her over-race early

races.paceDynamic: So Smart will lead from the gate with no serious pace pressure, as Solar Edge may sit prominent but the remaining five runners all prefer to hold up or settle midfield. This creates a slow, tactical affair over the minimum trip where So Smart can dictate fractions and potentially steal a march. The lack of genuine early pace means the race will likely develop into a sprint finish with hold-up horses trying to close down whatever lead So Smart has manufactured. This race shape strongly favours the front runner So Smart, who can control the tempo without pressure, and potentially one strong closer if the pace becomes crawling.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If So Smart gets soft fractions uncontested through the first three furlongs
scenarios.body: So Smart builds an unassailable lead as the hold-up brigade wake up too late over this minimum distance. The lack of early pressure allows the leader to have enough left to resist late challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Solar Edge applies more pressure early or So Smart goes too slow
scenarios.body: The pace becomes crawling and it turns into a dash from the two-furlong pole favouring horses with tactical speed. Hold-up horses with strong finishing kicks benefit from the stop-start nature.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Solar Edge tracks So Smart closely and times a challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: Solar Edge gets the ideal trip behind the leader and strikes at the optimal moment when So Smart begins to tire. The prominent runner gets first run on the closers while avoiding the leaders fate.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If So Smart goes extremely slowly and multiple horses get competitive early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete crawl with multiple runners in contention turning for home creating a cavalry charge finish. Superior class and finishing speed become the deciding factors rather than tactical position.

watchPoints.text: So Smart could steal this if getting uncontested fractions as the only natural leader in a small field lacking early pace.
Solar Edge's fitness after 145 days absence is crucial - if sharp could be the main danger tracking the leader.
The going has been called Good to Firm across all Bath races today which may help the faster finishers if the ground is playing fair.
Tyler Heard's partnership with So Smart could be significant as he knows how to maximize the front-running tactics from this draw.
Both Grace Harris runners So Smart and The Feminine Urge have identical last-run dates of 22 days suggesting stable has targeted this race.

races.paceDynamic: Eupator and Special Ghaiyyath will ensure a strong early gallop from the front, with both having confirmed leading tendencies and recent form suggesting they'll take the race on. The presence of two genuine pace-setters should create an honest tempo throughout, particularly over this mile trip where neither will want to give ground early. With five hold-up horses in the field, the early pace will be crucial in determining whether the leaders can sustain their effort or set it up for the closers. This pace dynamic strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leaders without getting involved in the early battle, as they can capitalize if the front two go too hard.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Go Too Hard
scenarios.trigger: If Eupator and Special Ghaiyyath engage in a pace duel through the first half-mile
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop will take its toll on both front-runners, allowing the hold-up horses to pick up the pieces in the final furlong with their superior finishing kicks. The good to firm going will suit the closers who can unleash their speed late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If one leader establishes a clear advantage while the other settles behind
scenarios.body: Special Ghaiyyath's recent winning form suggests he can dictate terms more effectively than Eupator, potentially stealing a march on the field. His two wins from eleven similar going runs give him the edge in a tactical battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Aspull Tracks Perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If Aspull can secure an ideal position behind the leaders without expending energy early
scenarios.body: Rossa Ryan can use Aspull's prominent style to maximum effect, tracking the pace-setters before striking in the final two furlongs. His recent win and strong form on good going makes him dangerous from this tactical position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Eupator and Special Ghaiyyath fail to establish a strong gallop due to tactical riding
scenarios.body: A slow early pace would turn this into a sprint finish where the highest-rated horses can utilize their class advantage. This scenario would particularly suit those with recent race fitness and strong finishing speed.

watchPoints.text: Special Ghaiyyath and Eupator in the early stages - if they go too fast together they'll set it up for the closers
Aspull's positioning in the first half-mile - needs to avoid getting caught up in any early pace battle to be effective late
Happy Banner's market support given the long absence and headgear application suggests stable confidence in improved performance
Candonomore's quick turnaround from six days ago could indicate either peak fitness or potential bounce risk
The overall pace scenario - with only two natural leaders, any reluctance from either could create a falsely run race

races.paceDynamic: Miss Mambo and Beryl's Girl will contest the early lead, with Arvana Belle and Takeitorleaveit tracking close behind in prominent positions. The pace should be sustainable rather than frantic given only two natural front runners over this 1m trip. Zoustellar and Denby's Dream will settle towards the back as hold-up horses, while Mali Star adopts similar waiting tactics. This measured pace favours prominent runners who can track the leaders without being shuffled back, as they'll get first run on the field when the tempo lifts entering the home straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest and the front two don't go too fast early
scenarios.body: The prominent quartet get perfect trips tracking the leaders and have too much tactical advantage when the race develops. Hold-up horses are left with too much to do as the pace never truly collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Mambo and Beryl's Girl go too fast trying to make all
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable and the field compacts in the final 2f, allowing the closers to unleash their finishing kicks. Zoustellar's recent win shows he thrives when getting a strong pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Mambo gets a soft lead and Beryl's Girl doesn't press hard enough
scenarios.body: The leader gets away with easy fractions and has enough left to repel all challengers in the straight. The prominent horses are close enough but can't quite reel in the determined front runner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both Miss Mambo and Beryl's Girl show early speed but neither wants the lead
scenarios.body: A crawling pace develops with the field bunched up turning for home, creating a sprint finish that suits any horse with a turn of foot. The race becomes a lottery with positioning crucial in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Miss Mambo and Beryl's Girl both show early pace as neither has raced recently and both may be ring-rusty
Monitor Zoustellar's position turning into the straight as he needs room to unleash his finishing kick from off the pace
